    Checked 2026-10-15

    Essentials

    Entry rules, getting around, safety and a few words of Thai.

    Apps to install

    Emergency numbers

    1155Tourist Police (English, 24 hours) · Scams, theft, disputes. Also via the SOS function in the Thailand Tourist Police app.1669Ambulance / medical emergency · National emergency medical service.191Police (also general emergency) · Can also send an ambulance or fire service.199Fire1196Water and boat accidents1672TAT tourist hotline · Tourist information and help.1178Immigration Bureau · Visa and length-of-stay questions.1441Cyber Police · Online scams, fake TDAC websites.1719Bangkok Hospital Phuket emergency · From Thai numbers. From any phone: +66 76 254 425.+66 76 361 888Bangkok Hospital Siriroj · Emergency also via 1719 from Thai numbers.+66 76 361 234Vachira Phuket Hospital (government)+66 76 237 220Mission Hospital Phuket+66 76 342 633Patong Hospital (government)
    Entry and visa

    TDAC arrival card: required Must know

    Every foreign visitor must fill in the free Thailand Digital Arrival Card online before arrival. You can send it in the 3 days (72 hours) before you land. For 8 Jan, do it on 6 or 7 Jan; the arrival day also works. Have your flight number and hotel address ready. Save the confirmation on your phone.

    Official TDAC website ↗Royal Thai Embassy: TDAC rules ↗Royal Thai Embassy: how to submit the TDAC ↗

    Fake TDAC websites Must know

    Use only tdac.immigration.go.th. Fake sites look official, charge about 20-90 USD and steal passport data. In March 2026 Immigration said about 1 in 10 foreign arrivals had used a fake site. The real TDAC is always free. Immigration's new THIM app is optional. Report fakes to the Cyber Police on 1441.

    Tourism Ministry warning (Oct 2025) ↗News: fake TDAC sites (Mar 2026) ↗TAT: THIM app (optional) ↗

    Visa-free stay is now 30 days

    Since 15 Sep 2026 the visa-free stay is 30 days (not 60), for tourism only. It covers 60 countries, including all EU states, the UK, US, Israel, Georgia and Ukraine. Russia and Kazakhstan also get 30 days under bilateral deals. Your 8-26 Jan trip (19 days) fits. Check your passport on the Thai e-Visa site.

    TAT: new visa exemption rules ↗Thai e-Visa (official) ↗

    Passport, ticket and money

    Your passport must be valid at least 6 months after arrival and have a free page. Officers may ask for a ticket out of Thailand within 30 days, your hotel booking and proof of money (10,000-20,000 baht per person; sources differ). Checks are random, but some people were refused entry. Keep these papers on your phone.

    UK travel advice: entry rules ↗Royal Thai Embassy London: visa exemption ↗

    Customs: cigarette limit

    You may bring at most 200 cigarettes (1 carton) per person. Customs checks this on arrival. Above the limit, the cigarettes are usually taken and the fine can be 10 times their value. Vapes and heated-tobacco devices are banned completely (see Safety and law).

    UK travel advice: entry rules ↗

    No ETA needed

    The planned Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA) has not started (Oct 2026). In 2025 Thailand replaced the plan with the TDAC. If your passport is visa-exempt, the TDAC is the only online form you need before the trip.

    ETA replaced by TDAC (Fragomen, Jul 2025) ↗

    Tourist entry fee: not yet

    A 450-baht entry fee for foreign visitors is planned. The target is early 2027, first for air arrivals. In Oct 2026 it still needed Cabinet approval and a Royal Gazette notice, so it is not in force yet, and the plan can still change. Check the news before you fly.

    News: Khaosod English, 9 Oct 2026 ↗News: The Star, 13 Sep 2026 ↗

    Flights via the Middle East

    The UK government warns that the conflict in the Middle East has closed some airspace and caused delays and cancellations (Oct 2026). If your flight goes via the Gulf, check it with your airline before you leave. Make sure your travel insurance covers flight disruption.

    UK travel advice: warnings ↗
    Getting around

    Grab and Bolt

    Both apps work in Phuket and show the price first. Typical car fares: airport to Patong 600-950 baht, Patong to Kata 250-500, Patong to Old Town 400-550. Bolt is often a bit cheaper, so compare. Prices go up at busy times and in heavy rain. If pickup is hard, walk to the main road.

    Grab Thailand ↗Bolt in Phuket ↗

    From the airport

    Grab pickup is near Exit 8 (international) or Exit 1 (domestic). Airport limousine taxis have fixed prices on a board, about 800 baht to Patong; metered taxis add a 100-baht airport fee. Cheapest: Smart Bus (100 baht) to the west-coast beaches, or the Airport Bus (100 baht) to Phuket Town.

    Phuket airport transfers guide (2026) ↗

    Taxis and tuk-tuks: agree the price first

    Street taxis and tuk-tuks almost never use the meter. They quote fixed prices, often much higher than the apps (Patong to Kata about 500-600 baht; Grab about 250-350). Agree the price before you get in and show the app price to bargain. Carry small notes. If a driver cheats you, call the Tourist Police on 1155.

    Phuket taxi prices 2026 (guide) ↗

    Scooter rental: licence and insurance

    To ride legally you need a motorcycle licence from home plus an International Driving Permit that covers motorcycles. Without them, insurance usually pays nothing after a crash. Many rental scooters are not registered, so check the papers. Police checks are common. Never leave your passport as a deposit.

    TAT: driving rules for tourists ↗UK travel advice: road safety ↗

    Helmets and road safety

    Rider and passenger must wear a helmet; since June 2025 the fine is up to 2,000 baht. Thailand drives on the left. Phuket roads are steep, curvy and busy. Do not ride after drinking. After a party, Grab or a taxi is the safer choice.

    TAT: driving rules for tourists ↗News: 2,000-baht helmet fine (2025) ↗

    Phuket Smart Bus

    Route 1: Airport - Patong - Karon - Kata - Rawai, flat 100 baht. Route 2: Bus Terminal 2 - Phuket Town - Patong, 50 baht. The Dragon Line in Old Town is free. Pay by contactless card, Thai QR or cash. Last bus from the airport 23:30; last bus from Rawai to the airport 19:30.

    Smart Bus timetable and live tracking ↗Smart Bus fares and payment ↗Smart Bus last bus times ↗

    Local songthaew buses

    Open-sided songthaew buses leave Ranong Road (near the market) in Phuket Town for the main beaches, about every 30 minutes from about 06:00 to 18:00. They cost about 30-50 baht but are slow and do not run in the evening.

    Phuket blue bus guide ↗

    Typical drive times

    From the airport: Patong 50-90 min, Kata 60-90 min, Old Town 40-60 min, Natai (Phang Nga) 30-45 min. Patong to Kata 20-30 min, Patong to Old Town 30-45 min. Traffic is worst in the late afternoon, so leave early for flights.

    Island hopping

    Koh Phangan: fastest (fly + boat)

    There is no direct boat. Fly Phuket - Koh Samui with Bangkok Airways (55 min, 6-7 flights a day, about 3,000-5,000 baht one way in late 2026). From Samui airport, a Lomprayah van + boat goes to Koh Phangan: about 500 baht, or 700 to your hotel, 1-2 hours. Door to door about 5 hours.

    Bangkok Airways ↗Phuket to Koh Samui guide (Oct 2026) ↗Lomprayah timetable 2026 (official) ↗

    Koh Phangan: one bus + boat ticket

    Lomprayah sells one ticket: bus to Donsak pier, then a fast boat. Pickup about 07:30 at hotels in Patong, Kata, Karon, Rawai and Nai Harn, or 10:00 at Phuket airport. You reach Koh Phangan about 16:30. About 1,600 baht, or 1,800 with hotel drop-off (2026 timetable). Book a few days ahead.

    Lomprayah timetable 2026 (official) ↗12Go: Phuket to Koh Phangan ↗

    Koh Phangan: cheapest and slowest

    Public bus from Phuket Bus Terminal 2 to Surat Thani (about 4 hours), van to Donsak pier (about 1 hour), then a ferry to Thong Sala (about 2.5 hours). Total about 8-9 hours and roughly 600-900 baht. Only worth it on a tight budget.

    12Go: Phuket to Koh Phangan ↗

    Party trips: book early

    Flights, boats and rooms on Koh Phangan sell out around big party dates. Book early and check the last boat back. Koh Phangan's rainy season is roughly October to December. January still gets some showers (about 130 mm on 8 to 9 days, against about 30 mm in Phuket), so rain and choppy seas are more likely there. Do not plan a tight connection to a flight home.

    UK travel advice: rainy season ↗

    Phi Phi ferries from Rassada Pier

    Big ferries leave Rassada Pier (near Phuket Town) at about 08:30, 11:00, 13:30 and 15:00. They take about 2 hours and cost about 500-700 baht. Speedboats take about 1 hour for 750-850 baht. Pay the 20-baht island fee in cash at Tonsai pier.

    Andaman Wave Master (ferry) ↗Phuket to Phi Phi guide (Oct 2026) ↗

    Maya Bay and park fee

    Trips to Maya Bay and Phi Phi Le pay a national park fee: 400 baht for foreign adults, 200 for children. Some tours include it, others collect cash on the day. Swimming at Maya Bay is not allowed. The bay closes every year from 1 Aug to 30 Sep, so it is open in January.

    Phuket to Phi Phi guide (Oct 2026) ↗

    Krabi and Ao Nang

    Boats also run from Rassada Pier to Ao Nang in Krabi. The fastest speedboats take about 1-1.5 hours; ferries that stop at Phi Phi take much longer. Schedules change by season, so check times on 12Go.

    12Go (ferries, buses, flights) ↗

    Day tours: Chalong and Ao Po piers

    Many speedboat day tours (Phi Phi, Racha, Coral Island) leave from Chalong Pier in the south. Some boats leave from Ao Po Grand Marina in the north-east. Most tours include hotel pickup. Ask which pier before you book.

    How to book boats

    Book on 12Go or on the official sites (Lomprayah, Seatran, Bangkok Airways). Save e-tickets offline. Arrive at the pier 30-45 minutes early to swap the e-ticket for a boarding pass.

    12Go ↗Lomprayah ↗Seatran Discovery ↗
    Koh Phangan full-moon week (19–23 Jan)

    Plan for the week

    Go after the big group leaves: fly to Samui on Mon 18 Jan if they leave that morning, or on Tue 19. Mon 18: Chill Up and maybe a Seaside pre-Full Moon party. Tue 19: OXA or the Lighthouse. Wed 20: Waterfall. Thu 21: Jungle Experience. Fri 22: the Full Moon Party. Sat 23: boat to Samui and the 15:05 flight back to Phuket for Circoloco.

    Full Moon dates (party week 20-24 Jan) ↗

    Fastest way: fly Phuket to Koh Samui, then a boat Must know

    Bangkok Airways is the only nonstop airline from Phuket (HKT) to Koh Samui (USM). On Mon 18 and Tue 19 Jan 2027 there are 8 flights a day, 55 minutes: 07:30, 09:45, 11:00, 12:55, 14:15, 16:35, 17:30 and 19:55, from about 4,730 THB one way (Google Flights, 16 Oct 2026). Take the 14:15 flight or earlier. Later flights miss the last boats to Thong Sala; only the Haad Rin Queen speedboat at 18:30 still goes to Haad Rin.

    Bangkok Airways ↗Google Flights HKT-USM 18 Jan ↗

    Samui airport to Koh Phangan in one ticket

    Lomprayah sells airport-to-Phangan tickets with the van to Bangrak pier included: about every hour from 07:30 to 15:00 and a last one at 17:00, 500 THB, about 1 hour to Thong Sala pier (700 THB with a drop at your hotel; 2026 timetable). Seatran Discovery has airport departures at 07:30, 09:00, 12:00 and 14:00 on 18-19 Jan 2027, also 500 THB (670 THB to your hotel).

    Lomprayah timetable 2026 (PDF) ↗Lomprayah booking ↗Seatran Discovery booking ↗

    Pier to pier: Samui to Koh Phangan

    From Bangrak pier (near the airport) Lomprayah boats leave about every hour from 08:00 to 17:30, 350 THB, 30 minutes to Thong Sala; Seatran leaves at 08:00, 09:30, 12:30 and 14:30 (350 THB). The Haad Rin Queen goes from Bangrak straight to Haad Rin: ferry 10:30 and 17:00 (200 THB, 50 min), speedboat 15:00 and 18:30 (500 THB, 25 min).

    Haad Rin Queen schedule ↗Lomprayah timetable ↗

    Bus + boat from Phuket in one ticket (slow but cheap)

    Lomprayah picks you up in Patong, Kata, Karon, Rawai or Nai Harn at 07:30, or at Phuket airport (gate 1-2) at 10:00, and you reach Koh Phangan at 16:30 by bus and catamaran: 1,600 THB, or 1,800 THB with a drop at your hotel. From its Phuket Town office it leaves at 09:30 for 1,400 THB. Kamala is not in the pickup zone. Cheaper bus + ferry tickets via Surat Thani (Phantip, Raja Ferry and others) cost about 600-900 THB and take most of the day.

    Lomprayah timetable 2026 (PDF, Phuket pages) ↗12Go: Phuket to Koh Phangan ↗

    Raja car ferry (only with a car or a bus ticket)

    Raja Ferry crosses from Donsak on the mainland to Thong Sala at 05:00, 08:00, 11:00, 14:00 and 18:00 (2 h 30 min), and from Lipa Noi on Samui in about 1 h 30 min. It is slow; you only use it on a bus + ferry ticket or with a car.

    Raja Ferry schedule ↗

    Back to Phuket on Sat 23 Jan for Circoloco Must know

    Samui to Phuket flights on Sat 23 Jan 2027: 08:15, 09:20, 11:10, 15:05, 15:50, 18:15 and 19:00 (1 hour, about 4,900 THB on 16 Oct 2026). The realistic plan after the Full Moon night: a 10:30 or 11:00 Seatran boat (or the 10:45 Lomprayah) from Thong Sala to Bangrak, then the 15:05 flight; you land at 16:05 and reach Baba Beach Club Natai (about 30 min) around 17:00. Circoloco runs 15:00-03:00. Book this flight now: there are only 7 a day.

    Google Flights USM-HKT 23 Jan ↗Seatran Discovery booking ↗

    Earliest boats from Koh Phangan on Sat 23 Jan Must know

    From Thong Sala the first boat is the Lomprayah speedboat at 07:30 to Bangrak (arrives 08:00, 350 THB; 2026 timetable). With its van ticket (500 THB) you are at Samui airport at 08:30, in time for the 09:20 flight. Later: Seatran 10:30 and 11:00 (500 THB with the airport transfer, at the airport 12:00 or 12:30). From Haad Rin: Haad Rin Queen ferry 09:30 (200 THB) or speedboat 12:30 (500 THB) to Bangrak.

    Lomprayah timetable 2026 (PDF) ↗Haad Rin Queen schedule ↗

    Backup if the flights are full

    The Lomprayah bus + boat leaves Thong Sala at 11:00 and reaches its Phuket Town office at 18:30 (1,400 THB, 2026 timetable). Other bus + ferry tickets to Phuket Bus Terminal 2 leave in the morning and take 10-12 hours; check 12Go for times. From Phuket Town it is about 1 hour by taxi north to Natai.

    Lomprayah timetable 2026 (PDF) ↗12Go: Koh Phangan to Phuket ↗

    Full Moon week: rooms cost more, book now Must know

    In party week rooms near Haad Rin cost about 2-3 times the normal price, and many places ask for a 3-5 night minimum stay. Haad Rin sells out weeks before, and January is also peak season. Book in October or November. Ban Tai and Thong Sala are much cheaper bases.

    Full Moon guide (Visit Thailand Today) ↗Full Moon budget (prices) ↗

    Where to stay: Ban Tai is the best base

    Most parties this week are in the Ban Tai hills or on its beach: OXA, Jungle Experience, Waterfall, Retro Mountain, Unclave, Chill Up and Sabaii. Haad Rin (Full Moon, Lighthouse, taxi boats to Eden) is 10-20 minutes away by taxi, and Thong Sala pier about 10 minutes. Stay in Haad Rin only if you want to walk home from the Full Moon Party and accept the minimum stay.

    Where to stay (Visit Thailand Today) ↗

    Getting around at night

    Shared taxis (pickup trucks, called songthaew) run late between Thong Sala, Ban Tai and Haad Rin on party nights. They have no meter, so agree the price per person before you get in. A guide gives about 200 THB per person from Thong Sala to Haad Rin. For Eden Garden and Bambu take a 4x4 truck from the Ban Tai 7-Eleven or a taxi boat from Haad Rin.

    Eden Garden transport info ↗Full Moon budget (taxi prices) ↗

    Scooters: better not at night Must know

    Thai law requires a helmet. Many rental scooters are not registered for the road, and without a licence that covers motorbikes your travel insurance may not pay (UK travel advice). A scooter rental blog says the steep Haad Rin hill and riding home after drinking are the two biggest causes of scooter accidents on Koh Phangan. On party nights take a taxi.

    UK travel advice: Thailand safety ↗Scooter to the Full Moon Party (Byklo, 2026) ↗

    Full Moon Party safety Must know

    Buy your own bucket and watch it being mixed: drinks are strong, spiking happens, and drinks with methanol can kill (UK travel advice). Stay away from the fire rope and fire limbo, and do not swim at night. Leave passport and cards in the room safe, carry a photo of your passport and small cash, and agree a meeting point with your friend.

    UK travel advice: Thailand safety ↗Full Moon guide (Visit Thailand Today) ↗

    Drugs, vapes and police Must know

    Even small amounts of drugs can mean heavy fines or prison, and police are active on party nights. Vapes and e-cigarettes are illegal in Thailand: fines are usually 5,000-30,000 THB, with no exception for tourists. In an emergency call the Tourist Police on 1155.

    UK travel advice: Thailand safety ↗

    What to bring

    Cash: the Full Moon entry (200 THB), the taxis, and OXA and the Hollystone bar take cash only. ATMs in Haad Rin can run out around the full moon, and each withdrawal costs 250-350 THB. Bring closed shoes (broken glass on the sand), clothes you do not mind ruining with UV paint, a waterproof phone pouch, a small torch for the paths to Eden and Lighthouse, a power bank, and your passport or ID (Jungle Experience and Hollystone are 20+).

    Full Moon Party basics ↗Full Moon guide (phangan.events) ↗

    Find each week's parties

    Most January line-ups and small parties are posted only 1-2 weeks before. Check the phangan.events calendar and the Phangan Party Guide channel on Telegram, which posts the parties of each day.

    phangan.events calendar ↗Phangan Party Guide (Telegram) ↗

    If you stay longer on Koh Phangan

    If you skip Circoloco: Eden Garden and Hollystone (Sat 23), Waterfall, Bambu and a WET pool party (Sun 24). Fly back to Phuket on Mon 25 Jan (Samui flights from 08:15 to 19:00). Do not leave it for Tue 26: a late boat or a delayed Samui flight could make you miss the 18:20 flight home.

    Google Flights USM-HKT 25 Jan ↗Seatran Discovery booking ↗
    SIM, eSIM and Wi-Fi

    Tourist SIM or eSIM

    AIS and True sell tourist plans with unlimited 5G/4G data. AIS 2026 prices: 8 days 499 baht, 15 days 699 baht. True: 15 days 699, 30 days 1,199. For 8-26 Jan (19 days) take a 30-day plan (True: 1,199 baht) or a 15-day plan plus a top-up. You need your passport to register.

    AIS tourist plans ↗True tourist SIM ↗

    Airport counter or eSIM before you fly

    AIS and True counters are in the international arrivals hall at Phuket airport. Or buy an AIS or True eSIM online before the trip, or use an eSIM app such as Airalo. Check that your phone supports eSIM. Keep your home SIM on for bank SMS codes.

    Wi-Fi

    Most hotels, cafes and malls have free Wi-Fi. AIS tourist plans include AIS Super WiFi hotspots. Signal can be weak on boats and small islands, so download maps and tickets before you go.

    Safety and law

    Vapes and e-cigarettes are illegal Must know

    It is illegal to bring, own or use any vape, e-cigarette, pod, e-liquid or heated-tobacco device (like IQOS). There are no exceptions for tourists. Penalties: confiscation, fines of about 5,000-30,000 baht, detention and court. You may have to stay in Thailand until the case ends. Leave it at home.

    UK travel advice: local laws ↗

    Drugs: very strict laws Must know

    Even small amounts of drugs can mean heavy fines, prison, deportation and a ban from Thailand. Police raid parties and villas, also on Koh Phangan, and do urine tests; a positive test can lead to charges. Serious cases can mean life in prison or the death penalty. Never carry anything for others.

    UK travel advice: local laws ↗News: Koh Phangan villa raid (Jan 2026) ↗

    New deportation rules

    Since 28 Aug 2026 Thailand can deport foreigners without a criminal conviction if officials decide their behaviour is against public order or public morals. People who are deported may not be allowed back. Follow local laws and police instructions.

    UK travel advice: safety and law ↗

    Cannabis: medical use only

    Since June 2025 cannabis is for medical use only: you need a Thai prescription (max 30-day supply). Recreational use is illegal, even though you still see shops. Do not smoke in public. Taking cannabis out of Thailand is a crime: fines from 30,000 baht per kg and an immigration watchlist.

    UK travel advice: local laws ↗

    Drink spiking and fake alcohol

    At parties, never leave your drink alone and do not accept open drinks from strangers. Methanol in fake or cheap spirits can kill; get help fast if someone has blurred vision or feels very sick after drinking. Plan your ride home before you go out.

    UK travel advice: safety ↗

    Alcohol sale hours

    Shops and most bars may sell alcohol from 11:00 to midnight; the old 14:00-17:00 ban has ended. Licensed hotels, clubs and airports may serve outside these hours. The legal drinking age is 20. Since Nov 2025, drinkers can also be fined up to 10,000 baht for drinking at banned times or places.

    UK travel advice: local laws ↗News: new sale hours (May 2026) ↗News: fines for drinkers (Nov 2025) ↗

    No smoking on the beach

    Since 2018 smoking is banned on Patong Beach and other listed Thai beaches: fine up to 100,000 baht and/or up to 1 year in jail. Use the marked smoking areas and never leave cigarette butts. Smoking in other public places can also bring a fine of up to 5,000 baht.

    The Nation: Patong beach smoking ban ↗

    Jet-ski scams

    Some jet-ski operators blame tourists for old damage and ask for big money. Never leave your passport as a deposit. Film the jet ski from all sides before you ride. If there is a dispute, stay calm and call the Tourist Police on 1155.

    UK travel advice: safety ↗

    Rip currents and flags

    In January the west-coast sea is usually calm, but rip currents still happen. Swim near lifeguards and never swim at a red flag. If a current pulls you out, do not fight it: swim parallel to the beach, then back in. Do not swim drunk or at night.

    UK travel advice: swimming ↗

    Drones need permits

    Register every drone with the NBTC within 30 days of arrival; camera drones also need CAAT registration (with a Thai SIM). You need 1 million baht third-party insurance and CAAT approval at least 3 days before each flight. No flying within 9 km of airports. Unregistered drone: up to 100,000 baht and/or 5 years in jail.

    TAT: drone guide for tourists (2026) ↗CAAT drone portal ↗NBTC drone registration ↗

    Carry ID

    Police can ask to see your passport. Carry it, or at least a copy of the photo page and entry stamp. A copy is usually fine, but you may have to show the original at a police station within 24 hours.

    UK travel advice: local laws ↗
    Your solo days (24–26 Jan)

    Social hostels in Patong

    Mad Monkey Phuket (Patong, 9.8 on Hostelworld) has a 'Meet Up' every evening at 19:00 with half-price beer, pub crawls on Tuesday and Thursday and a foam party on Saturday. Lub d Patong has pool party nights; Zostel Patong has daily pub crawls and pool parties. Dorm beds at Mad Monkey and Lub d: about 1,000-1,400 baht a night on 23-25 Jan.

    Mad Monkey Phuket (Hostelworld) ↗Lub d Phuket Patong (Hostelworld) ↗Zostel Phuket Patong (Hostelworld) ↗

    Hostelworld app chats

    Book a bed through Hostelworld, and the app opens chats with people in your hostel and in Phuket 7 days before check-in. 'Linkups' are meet-ups that hostels and travellers post, from dinners to nights out.

    Hostelworld social features (official) ↗

    Find the techno people

    Check Resident Advisor with the location set to Thailand (its Phuket page stays empty; Shelter has a club page there), and the Instagram pages of Shelter, Courage Bar and SUB (FAKE PALM nights show up on RA and Megatix): small parties are posted only 1-3 weeks ahead. Go early, stand near the booth and talk to the DJs and bar staff. They know the after-parties.

    Shelter Phuket on Resident Advisor ↗Shelter on Instagram ↗Courage Bar on Instagram ↗SUB on Instagram ↗

    Join-in boat trips

    Group boat tours are sold per person, so going alone costs the same. Examples: Khai Islands half day about 1,100 baht, James Bond Island 1,400-3,500, Phi Phi by speedboat 1,500-3,500. Pickup is often extra from Kamala or Nai Yang, and ask if the park fee is included. Book 1-2 days ahead on Klook or GetYourGuide.

    Klook ↗GetYourGuide ↗

    Drinks at parties Must know

    Buy your own drinks and watch them being poured, or take closed cans and bottles. Never leave a drink alone, and never take pills or open drinks from strangers. Police raid parties and do urine tests, and drug use is a crime. If you suddenly feel very drunk or sick, tell security and call 1669.

    UK travel advice: safety and law ↗Party raid with urine tests (Khaosod, Oct 2025) ↗

    Plan the ride home

    Before you go out, check that Grab or Bolt works from the venue and keep at least 1,000 baht in cash for the ride, more for long rides. For Circoloco in Natai (Sat 23 Jan, until 03:00), book a driver for both ways. In Grab, use 'Share My Ride' so a friend can follow your car live.

    Grab: Share My Ride (official) ↗Bolt in Phuket (official) ↗

    Phone, money and passport

    Clubs check your age (20+) with your passport, so carry it in a zip pocket and leave spare cards and most cash in the hotel safe. Take one card and some cash. Charge your phone, bring a small power bank and save your hotel in Google Maps offline.

    UK travel advice: carry ID ↗

    Share your location

    Before a night out, share your live location with a friend: Google Maps can share until you turn it off, and WhatsApp for up to 8 hours. Send the party name, your hotel and when you plan to be back. Message 'home safe' when you arrive.

    Google Maps: location sharing (official) ↗

    Help numbers

    Tourist Police 1155 (English, 24 hours), ambulance 1669, police 191. The Thailand Tourist Police app has an SOS button that sends your GPS position, and a live chat with officers in English. Install it before you go out.

    TAT: Tourist Police app ↗

    Budget for a room alone

    Most hotel rooms cost the same for one person as for two. For 23-26 Jan, expect about 400-1,800 baht for a dorm bed, 800-1,400 for a private room with a shared bathroom, and 2,100-3,600 for a room with your own bathroom or a mid-range hotel. Saturday 23 Jan is often the most expensive night.

    Hostels in Phuket (Hostelworld) ↗
    Health

    Bangkok Hospital Phuket (private)

    Large private hospital in Phuket Town (2/1 Hongyok Utis Road) with English-speaking staff and a 24-hour emergency room. Emergency: 1719 from a Thai number, or +66 76 254 425. It is expensive, so have travel insurance.

    Bangkok Hospital Phuket ↗

    Bangkok Hospital Siriroj (private)

    Big private hospital of the same group, on the bypass road near Central Phuket (44 Chalermprakiat Ror 9 Road). English-speaking staff and a 24-hour emergency room. Phone +66 76 361 888; emergency 1719 from a Thai number.

    Bangkok Hospital Siriroj ↗

    Mission Hospital Phuket (private)

    Mid-size private hospital at 4/1 Thepkrasattri Road in Phuket Town, with a 24-hour emergency room. Usually cheaper than the Bangkok Hospital group. Phone +66 76 237 220.

    Mission Hospital Phuket ↗

    Vachira Phuket Hospital (government)

    Phuket's main government hospital (353 Yaowarat Road, Phuket Town) with a 24-hour emergency and trauma centre. Cheaper, but waits can be long and English can be limited. Phone +66 76 361 234.

    Vachira Phuket Hospital (Thai) ↗

    Patong Hospital (government)

    Small government hospital in Patong (57 Sai Nam Yen Road), the closest hospital to Bangla Road. It has a 24-hour emergency room for first care; serious cases go to the big hospitals in Phuket Town. Phone +66 76 342 633.

    Patong Hospital (Thai) ↗

    Ambulance and insurance

    Call 1669 for an ambulance (191 also works). Hospitals ask for a payment guarantee or insurance before treatment. Get travel insurance that covers hospital, evacuation and your activities (boats, diving, scooter only with a valid licence). Save the insurer's phone number.

    UK travel advice: health ↗

    Pharmacies

    Pharmacies are everywhere, including Boots and Watsons in malls. Many basic medicines are sold without a prescription. Do not buy medicine on the street; it may be fake. Bring your own medicines in the original packs with a copy of the prescription.

    UK travel advice: health ↗

    Sun and heat

    In January the midday UV index is high to extreme (about 8-11). Use high-SPF sunscreen, a hat and sunglasses, and stay in the shade around midday. Drink plenty of water, especially at parties. Heat stroke can be deadly.

    CDC: Thailand travel health ↗

    Mosquitoes and dengue

    Dengue fever exists in Thailand. The mosquitoes bite mostly in the daytime. Use repellent with 20% or more DEET and sleep in air-con or screened rooms. See a doctor if you get a high fever. Ask your doctor about vaccines such as hepatitis A before the trip.

    CDC: Thailand travel health ↗

    Tap water and animals

    Do not drink tap water; drink bottled or filtered water. Keep away from stray dogs and monkeys, as rabies exists. If an animal bites or scratches you, wash the wound with soap and water and see a doctor the same day.

    CDC: Thailand travel health ↗
    Weather in January

    Dry, hot and sunny

    January is one of the driest months in Phuket. The average high is about 32-33°C and the low about 23-25°C. Rain is about 30-36 mm in the whole month, on about 5-6 days, and a short shower is always possible. Humidity is about 70-76%.

    Thai Meteorological Department ↗Phuket climate table (TMD 1981-2010) ↗

    Sea conditions

    On the west coast (Patong, Karon, Kata, Bang Tao) the Andaman Sea is usually calm and clear in January. The water is about 28°C. It is the best season for swimming, snorkelling and boat trips, but still check the beach flags.

    Sunrise and sunset

    During your trip, sunrise is 06:42-06:46 and sunset 18:23-18:31 (on 19 Jan: 06:45 and 18:28). It gets dark about 20-25 minutes after sunset. West-coast beaches face the sunset.

    Peak season

    January is high season. Prices are highest over Christmas and New Year and stay high all month. Popular tours, boats and good rooms fill up fast, so book the important things early.

    Etiquette

    Temples: dress code

    Cover shoulders and knees: no tank tops, short shorts or short skirts. Take off your shoes before you enter a temple building. Do not point your feet at a Buddha image. Some temples lend sarongs at the entrance.

    Royal family: show respect

    Never criticise or joke about the King or the royal family, also not online. It is a crime with long prison terms. Stand when the royal anthem plays, for example in cinemas before the film. Do not step on money, because it shows the King.

    UK travel advice: local laws ↗

    Shoes, head and feet

    Take off your shoes when you enter homes, temples, massage rooms and some shops; if you see shoes at the door, do the same. Do not touch people's heads. Do not point your feet at people or put them on tables.

    The wai

    The wai is the Thai greeting: palms together at the chest and a small bow. Return a wai from adults. You do not need to wai staff or children; a smile and sawasdee krap or ka is fine. Women should not touch monks.

    Tipping

    Tipping is not required but welcome. Many hotels and restaurants add a 10% service charge, so check the bill. Round up taxi fares. Leave about 50-100 baht for a massage or a good guide.

    Haggling

    Bargain at markets, with tuk-tuks and for tours sold on the street. Do not bargain in malls, 7-Eleven, restaurants or shops with fixed prices. Smile and stay calm; anger and shouting do not work in Thailand.

    Power and apps

    Plugs and voltage

    Thailand uses 220-230 V, 50 Hz. Most sockets take flat US-style pins (type A/B) and round two-pin European plugs (type C). UK and Australian plugs need an adapter. Phone and laptop chargers marked 100-240 V work fine.

    Grab, Bolt and inDrive

    Install Grab and Bolt before you arrive and add a payment card. Compare both for each ride. inDrive also works in Phuket and lets you offer your own price.

    Grab Thailand ↗Bolt in Phuket ↗

    Google Translate with offline Thai

    Download Thai for offline use in Google Translate. The camera mode reads menus and signs, and conversation mode helps with drivers.

    How to translate offline ↗

    Google Maps offline area

    Download offline maps of Phuket and Phang Nga (and Koh Phangan if you go). Save your hotel and favourite places. Show the map to drivers to explain where you want to go.

    How to download offline maps ↗

    LINE

    LINE is the main chat app in Thailand. Many hotels, drivers, tour shops and clubs have a LINE account and answer messages there.

    LINE ↗

    12Go

    Book ferries, buses, vans and domestic flights in one app. If the trip has an 'e-ticket' sign, the PDF on your phone is enough. If not, print the voucher and swap it for a ticket at the counter. Check the pier and pickup time carefully.

    12Go ↗

    Klook and GetYourGuide

    Book tours, boat trips and tickets with reviews and clear prices. Check what is included (hotel pickup, park fees, lunch) and the cancellation rules.

    Klook ↗GetYourGuide ↗

    Wise and ATMs

    A Wise or similar card gives a good exchange rate. In 2026 Thai bank ATMs charge foreign cards 250 baht (Visa) or 350 baht (Mastercard) per withdrawal, so take out larger amounts. Always choose to pay in baht (THB), not in your home currency.

    Wise ↗Thai ATM fees 2026 (guide) ↗

    Thailand Tourist Police app

    Official app with an SOS function that connects you to the Tourist Police (1155) and uses GPS to find you. Live chat in English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Russian.

    TAT: Tourist Police app ↗
    Flight home: Tue 26 Jan, 18:20

    Be at the airport by 15:20 Must know

    For the 18:20 flight, arrive about 3 hours before, by 15:20. Late January is high season, and the lines at check-in, security and passport control can be long. Most airlines close check-in 40-60 minutes before take-off, so check the time on your ticket.

    HKT departures board (official) ↗Phuket airport guide (Sep 2026) ↗

    When to leave for the airport Must know

    Leave Nai Yang by 15:00 (5-10 min), Kamala by 14:15 (40-60 min), Patong by 13:45 (50-90 min) and Kata by 13:15 (60-100 min). Traffic going north gets bad after 16:00, and heavy rain makes it slower.

    Drive times and rush hour (Phuket 101, Mar 2026) ↗

    Book the ride the day before

    In Grab, use 'Advance Booking'. You can book from 90 days to 75 minutes before pickup. The price is fixed and includes a booking fee of about 50-100 baht. Bolt also lets you book up to 90 days ahead. If your hotel books a car, agree the price first.

    Grab advance booking (official) ↗Grab booking fee (KTC, Apr 2026) ↗Bolt: book in advance (official) ↗Bolt in Phuket (official) ↗

    Cheapest ride: the Smart Bus

    Smart Bus Route 1 runs along the west coast to the airport for 100 baht. To arrive at about 14:50, take it at Kata Palm 12:47, Patong (Bangla police box) 13:20 or Kamala Big C 13:35. The bus before (12:12, 12:50, 13:05) arrives about 14:20 and is safer with traffic. Timetable from 16 Jan 2026: check it again before you go.

    Smart Bus timetable (official) ↗

    Check-out is at 11:00 or 12:00

    Most hotels near the airport want you out by 12:00. Proud Phuket's FAQ says 11:00, but its booking terms say 12:00, so ask at check-in. A late check-out depends on free rooms and often costs extra, so ask a few days before. Reception can usually keep your bags for the afternoon.

    Example: Proud Phuket FAQ (official) ↗Proud Phuket booking terms (official) ↗

    Left luggage at the airport

    AIRPORTELs has a counter in the international terminal, on the ground floor (called '1st floor' in Thailand), at Exit 2 (Door 2). It is open 06:00-24:00 and costs 150 baht per bag for 24 hours (Oct 2026). Leave your bags there, then go to Nai Yang Beach, 5-10 minutes away.

    AIRPORTELs Phuket (prices, booking) ↗AIRPORTELs international terminal counter ↗

    VAT refund: the shopping rules

    Buy in shops with the 'VAT Refund for Tourists' sign and spend at least 2,000 baht (with VAT) in one shop on one day. Show your passport and get the P.P.10 form and the original tax invoice; check that your name and passport number are right. You must fly out within 60 days. Hotels, food and services do not count.

    Revenue Department: conditions (official) ↗Revenue Department: FAQ (official) ↗

    VAT refund at Phuket airport

    If your goods total 20,000 baht or more, show them with the forms at the Customs VAT counter before check-in. Keep in your hand luggage any watch, phone, laptop, bag or jewellery of 40,000 baht or more, and anything of 100,000 baht or more. After passport control, go to the VAT Refund Office (3rd floor). Up to 30,000 baht is paid in cash there.

    HKT: VAT refund steps (official) ↗Revenue Department: FAQ (official) ↗

    No departure card, and e-gates

    There is no departure card: the paper TM6 card has not been used at airports since July 2022, and the TDAC is only for entering Thailand. Since 13 June 2026, HKT has automatic passport gates for departures. You need an e-passport valid for 6 more months and must be at least 120 cm tall. Take off your hat, glasses and mask.

    TAT: passport e-gates at HKT (Jun 2026) ↗TAT: TM6 cancelled for air travel ↗Thai embassy: TDAC is for entry ↗

    Power banks and liquids

    Power banks go only in hand luggage, max 2 per person. Up to 100 Wh is fine, 100-160 Wh needs airline approval, and bigger or unlabelled ones are not allowed. Since June 2026 you may not use or charge them on the plane; keep them in the seat pocket or under the seat. Liquids: max 100 ml per bottle, in one clear 1-litre bag.

    New Thai power bank rules (Jun 2026) ↗Power bank rules (ScandAsia, Jun 2026) ↗HKT: security and liquids (official) ↗

    No departure tax to pay

    The airport passenger fee is already in your ticket price: 1,120 baht for tickets issued from 20 June 2026 (730 baht before). You pay nothing extra at the airport.

    TAT: new passenger fee (May 2026) ↗

    A relaxed last day near the airport

    Check out, then leave your bags at reception or at AIRPORTELs. Have lunch at Natural Restaurant or on Nai Yang Beach, then choose a massage with a free airport drop-off, plane spotting at Mai Khao (best until about 14:00) or the 13:30 tour at Soi Dog (open on Tuesday). Be at the terminal by 15:20.

    Sabai Massage airport branch (official) ↗Soi Dog visiting hours (official) ↗

    Paid lounges after passport control

    The Coral lounges are on the international side, after passport control. You can buy a pass online, for example a 2.5-hour pass for the Coral Executive Lounge on Klook. Priority Pass works only in some of them, so check before you go up.

    HKT lounges (official) ↗Lounge pass guide (Jul 2026) ↗

    Checked 16 Oct 2026

    Apps and services

    What to install for this trip and what each app is for. Set up the must-haves at home: most of them send an SMS code to your phone number when you sign up.

    Install before you fly 12 apps

    Set these up at home, while your home SIM still gets the SMS codes. Tick each one when it is ready.

    G

    Grab: Taxi Ride, Food Delivery

    Getting around

    Main ride app in Phuket. Cars and motorbike taxis, with the price shown before you book. 2026 guides say it is the only ride app with an official pickup point at Phuket airport.

    At home
    Install at home and sign up with your own phone number. Grab sends a code by SMS, so do it while your home SIM works. Add a credit or debit card. No Thai SIM needed.
    Works
    Phuket: whole island, incl. the airport. Natai (Phang Nga): yes, since Mar 2025. Koh Samui: yes. Koh Phangan: no, there are no or almost no Grab drivers.
    Cost
    Free app. Fares shown before you book. Advance Booking adds a fee, about 50 baht for GrabCar (2026 guide).
    Tips & help
    • Airport, international arrivals: go out at Exit 8 and walk toward the domestic terminal to the Grab pickup point. Domestic: exit at Gate 1, turn right to the Grab booth.
    • Ride types at Phuket airport: JustGrab (nearest car or taxi), GrabCar, GrabCar Premium, GrabBike, and GrabSUV or GrabCar Plus for more space and luggage.
    • Advance Booking: book from 90 days up to 75 minutes before pickup, at a fixed price. Use it for the ride to the airport on 26 Jan.
    • Safety: tap 'Share my ride' so a friend can follow your car live. The emergency button alerts help. The in-app chat translates your messages.
    • GrabBike is a motorbike taxi for one person. Legal riders have yellow number plates. You must wear the helmet.
    • 2026 guides: about 600-950 baht from the airport to Patong and 250-380 from Patong to Kamala. Prices go up at busy times and in heavy rain.
    • Grab works in all of Phang Nga since Mar 2025, so you can book rides to and from Baba Beach Club in Natai. Pay by card or cash.
    • Foreign visitors can buy a Grab Travel Pass for Thailand in the app (Account > Subscription). The vouchers last 4 weeks from the day you buy. Check the price first.
    Grab pickup points at Phuket airport (official) ↗Grab Thailand: ride types, Advance Booking, safety ↗Grab Travel Pass ↗
    App StoreGoogle PlayWebsite
    L

    Lomprayah

    Ferries, flights and airport

    Big ferry company for Samui and Koh Phangan. Van + fast boat from Samui airport to Thong Sala, and back. Book on the website; there is no app.

    At home
    Book on lomprayah.com at home. Save the e-ticket email on your phone so you can open it offline.
    Works
    Samui airport (van to Bangrak pier) and Bangrak pier to Thong Sala pier on Koh Phangan. Also bus + boat tickets from Phuket.
    Cost
    Samui airport to Thong Sala 500 baht. Thong Sala to Bangrak pier 350 baht. Samui airport to or from your Koh Phangan hotel 700 baht (booking site, Jan 2027).
    Tips & help
    • 19 Jan 2027, Samui airport to Thong Sala: about every hour from 07:30 to 15:00, last at 17:00. The trip takes about 1 hour.
    • 23 Jan 2027, Thong Sala to Samui airport: 07:30, 10:45, 12:30, 13:40, 14:00 and later. The 10:45 is at the airport at 11:30, so it fits an afternoon flight.
    • Hotel ticket: a van picks you up at your Koh Phangan hotel (not Thong Nai Pan). On 23 Jan the 09:30 pickup is at Samui airport at 11:30. 700 baht.
    • On 16 Oct 2026 some boats showed only 2-5 seats left online. Book early for the full-moon week.
    • Be at the Lomprayah counter 60 minutes before departure to confirm your trip (Lomprayah terms).
    • Tickets cannot be refunded. One date change is free if you email at least 2 days before. 20 kg of luggage is free; more costs 200 baht.
    • Lost the email? Open 'My bookings' on lomprayah.com. Enter your email and ticket code, or get a 6-digit code by email, to show your ticket.
    • Help: phone or WhatsApp 065 350 9040 (08:00-20:00), LINE @pnd0714w.
    Timetable 2026 (official) ↗My bookings (find your ticket) ↗Terms: check-in, changes, luggage ↗

    BA

    Bangkok Airways

    Ferries, flights and airport

    Airline app for your Phuket - Samui flights: booking, online check-in and the boarding pass on your phone. Also shows where the airline's lounges are.

    At home
    Install at home and open your booking in the app. Check in from 24 hours before each flight and save the boarding pass.
    Works
    Phuket airport (domestic terminal) and Samui airport, which Bangkok Airways owns.
    Cost
    Free app.
    Tips & help
    • Online check-in opens 24 hours and closes 1 hour before departure, in the app or on the website.
    • The boarding pass on your phone is accepted at security and at the gate.
    • Domestic check-in counters close 40 minutes before departure. Drop your bags at least 30 minutes before.
    • Bring your passport. Since 2024 foreigners must show it on domestic flights, and the name must match the boarding pass.
    • The Boutique Lounge is open to all Bangkok Airways passengers, with free snacks, drinks and Wi-Fi. The Blue Ribbon lounge is for Business Class.
    How to check in (Bangkok Airways, Jan 2026) ↗Online check-in ↗

    GM

    Google Maps

    Maps and language

    Main map and navigation. Download offline areas at home, because signal is weak on boats, in the hills and at jungle parties.

    At home
    On Wi-Fi: profile picture > Offline maps > Select your own map. Download Phuket, Koh Samui and Koh Phangan. Save your hotels, venues and the piers.
    Works
    All of Thailand. Offline maps give driving routes only: no walking routes and no traffic offline.
    Cost
    Free.
    Tips & help
    • To download: tap your profile picture > Offline maps > Select your own map, move the box, then tap Download.
    • Offline you get driving directions only: no walking or transit directions and no traffic. Use Organic Maps to walk offline.
    • Google updates offline maps on Wi-Fi before they expire. Turn on 'Auto-update offline maps' in the Offline maps settings.
    • Save your hotels and party venues, and show the pin to drivers.
    • Offline maps expire. Turn on Offline maps > Settings > Auto-update offline maps.
    • Share live location: profile picture > Location sharing > New share. People without Google get a link that works up to 24 hours.
    • Save places: open a place, tap Save and pick a list. Make one list per island.
    • Show the map pin to drivers; Thai addresses are hard to say.
    Download maps to use offline (Google help) ↗Share your real-time location ↗

    GT

    Google Translate

    Maps and language

    Translate Thai text, read menus and signs with the camera, and talk with drivers using live translate.

    At home
    On Wi-Fi: tap the language at the top, find Thai and tap Download. Download your own language too. Test the camera in airplane mode.
    Works
    All of Thailand. Text and camera translation work offline after you download Thai.
    Tips & help
    • Camera: tap Camera under the text box and point it at the menu. Tap the shutter button to pause and read.
    • To talk: tap 'live translate' at the bottom and choose Conversation, or 'Face to face' so each person reads their own half of the screen.
    • Use short, simple sentences. Names and addresses translate badly; show the map pin instead.
    Download languages to use offline ↗Translate images with the camera ↗Live translate (conversation) ↗

    L

    LINE

    Chat

    The main chat app in Thailand, used by over 80% of people. Hotels, drivers, shops, money changers and some clubs answer on LINE. Many have a LINE Official Account.

    At home
    At home: tap Sign up, choose your home country, then 'Continue with Apple' or 'Continue with Google'. Outside Thailand and a few Asian countries, LINE no longer signs up with a phone number.
    Works
    All of Thailand, with mobile data or Wi-Fi.
    Tips & help
    • Add a shop by ID: Home tab > add-friend icon > Search > ID. Official Account IDs start with @, so type the @ too.
    • Add by QR code: Home tab > add-friend icon > QR code, then scan the code on the counter or poster.
    • Links like lin.ee/... or line.me/R/ti/p/@... open the account in LINE, where you can add it.
    • To let a driver add you, show your code: Home tab > add-friend icon > QR code > My QR code.
    • LINE is not in the Russian App Store (checked Oct 2026).
    LINE: creating a new account ↗LINE: adding friends (ID, QR, links) ↗

    W

    WhatsApp Messenger

    Chat

    Chat and calls on your home number. Many drivers, villas, tour shops, money changers and beach clubs that work with foreigners also use WhatsApp.

    At home
    Keep WhatsApp on your home number, also when a Thai SIM is in the phone. Turn on chat backup.
    Works
    All of Thailand, with mobile data or Wi-Fi.
    Tips & help
    • Save Thai numbers with +66 and drop the first 0: 081 234 5678 becomes +66 81 234 5678.
    • Share live location with your group at parties: in a chat tap + (or the clip) > Location > Share live location.
    • WhatsApp calls use data, not phone credit.
    App StoreGoogle PlayWebsite
    W

    Wise

    Money and payments

    Card and app that pays abroad at the mid-market rate plus a small fee. Use it for card payments in malls, hotels and Grab, and for cash from Thai ATMs.

    At home
    Open the account, verify your ID and order the plastic card early, because delivery takes some days. Add the card to Apple Pay or Google Wallet. Top up before you fly.
    Works
    Anywhere Visa or Mastercard is taken: Phuket, Koh Samui, Koh Phangan and Phuket airport. Cash works at any Thai bank ATM, also on Koh Phangan.
    Cost
    Free account. Card 7 GBP or 7 EUR (9 USD in the US). Changing to THB costs about 0.6-0.75% from GBP, EUR or USD (Wise prices, 16 Oct 2026). ATM: free up to 250 GBP/EUR/USD a month, then 2.69% (UK, Ireland) or 1.95 USD + 1.95% (US).
    Tips & help
    • Thai ATMs add their own fee: 250 baht with Visa, 350 baht with Mastercard (Kasikorn, SCB, Krungsri, GSB, 2026). Take out larger amounts.
    • Wise cards from Ireland and the EEA are Visa, so the Thai ATM fee is 250 baht. The network depends on the country of your card, so check yours.
    • If the ATM or card machine offers your home currency, say no and choose THB. The Wise rate is better.
    • The Wise app can pay Alipay+ QR codes (about 1.8-1.9% in total, Oct 2026), but not Thai PromptPay QR yet. Not for Wise accounts from the US, Canada or Japan.
    • Wise can also send baht to a Thai bank account, for example for a villa or tour deposit.
    Wise card fees (UK) ↗Wise QR payments (countries and fees) ↗

    TT

    Thailand Tourist Police

    Safety and health

    Official Tourist Police app (Royal Thai Police). SOS connects you to the 1155 call centre and uses GPS to find you. Also live chat with officers, crime reports and nearby police stations.

    At home
    Install it at home, sign up (a Google account works) and allow location access. Do not press SOS to test it. Save 1155 in your contacts as a backup.
    Works
    All of Thailand, including Koh Phangan, Samui and Phuket airport. Needs mobile data or Wi-Fi; no Thai SIM needed.
    Tips & help
    • Live chat and interpreters: English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Russian (TAT, Jul 2026).
    • Install 'Thailand Tourist Police' by Royal Thai Police. The older 'Tourist Police i lert u' app (iOS version from 2022) is a different app.
    • Store reviews (2025-2026) say sign-up, reports and SOS calls can fail. If it fails, call 1155: a normal call needs signal, not data.
    TAT: Tourist Police app features (Jul 2026) ↗UK travel advice: emergency numbers and the app ↗

    TE

    Thai emergency numbers

    Safety and health

    Numbers to save before the trip: Tourist Police 1155, ambulance 1669, police 191, fire 199, TAT tourist help 1672.

    At home
    Save all five numbers in your contacts. Also save your travel insurance emergency number.
    Works
    All of Thailand, including Koh Phangan, Samui and Phuket airport.
    Tips & help
    • 1155 is the Tourist Police: open 24/7, with help in several languages for emergencies and questions (TAT).
    • 1669 is the medical emergency (ambulance) number. 191 also works for police, fire and ambulance.
    • TAT Contact Centre 1672 answers 24 hours a day for tourist information and help (TAT, Sep 2026).
    TAT: Contact Centre 1672 open 24 hours (Sep 2026) ↗

    D

    DICE

    Parties and tickets

    Ticket app for Circoloco. Dice tickets live only in the app: no PDF, no email ticket, no print. At the door you show a QR code from the app.

    At home
    Install DICE and sign up with your phone number and your full name as in your passport. Dice uses this name to match your ID at the door.
    Works
    Circoloco at Baba Beach Club Natai (Phang Nga, about 1 hour north of Kamala), Sat 9, 16 and 23 Jan, 15:00 to 03:00. The app works anywhere with internet.
    Cost
    Free app. Dice shows the full price with fees. Circoloco from EUR 107.99 (16 Oct 2026).
    Tips & help
    • The QR appears on the day, about 2 hours before the start: open the ticket tab, pick the event, tap 'Activate QR Code'. Do not screenshot it.
    • Buying for the group? Use 'Send ticket to a friend' before activation, if the event allows it. Friends need a Dice account with the number in your contacts.
    • After activation you cannot send or return a ticket. If you all arrive together, you can show all tickets on one phone.
    • Circoloco on Dice is one listing for all three dates: max 6 tickets, refund only if the event is moved or cancelled, and not in the last 24 hours.
    • Dice says 18+, Ticketmelon says 20+. Plan for 20+ and bring your real passport: Dice says a photo of ID will likely not be accepted.
    • Logged out? When you log in again in the app, Dice sends the 4-digit code to your email, so it also works with a Thai SIM.
    • Phone lost or broken? Message Dice before the event. Most venues keep a Dice door list, where you show ID that matches your account name.
    • Sold out? Use the Dice wait list if the organiser turns it on. Never buy Dice tickets from strangers.
    Dice: activate your ticket on the day ↗Dice: send tickets to a friend ↗Circoloco Thailand 2027 on Dice ↗

    M

    Megatix (megatix.in.th)

    Parties and tickets

    Ticket website for most of your nights: Café del Mar shows, DnB Allstars, OXA, Jungle Experience and Hollystone. The e-ticket is a PDF with a QR code, sent by email.

    At home
    No app needed. Make a free account on megatix.in.th at home and buy early: the cheaper first releases sell out, then prices go up.
    Works
    Phuket: Café del Mar (Kamala), DnB Allstars (Azulea, Chalong, 22 to 24 Jan). Koh Phangan: OXA, Jungle Experience, Hollystone. Online, anywhere.
    Cost
    Free account. A service fee is added at checkout. DnB Allstars lists card, PromptPay QR and TrueMoney as payment.
    Tips & help
    • The 'Megatix' app in the stores is a ticket scanner for organisers. You do not need it.
    • The PDF comes by email right after you pay. Lost it? Log in, click your name at the top, choose 'Tickets' and download it again.
    • Show the QR on your phone and zoom in so the whole code is on screen. Each ticket lets one person in, once.
    • Use megatix.in.th. The address megatix.co.th is a parked domain, not Megatix.
    • Café del Mar, Hollystone, Jungle Experience and DnB Allstars pages say 20+, OXA pages say 18+. DnB Allstars checks ID: non-Thais need a passport.
    • The ticket name is the buyer's account. DnB Allstars allows transfers only by its name-change process, up to 7 days before 22 Jan.
    • Café del Mar sells through a Megatix box on its own event pages. For big names, sign up there to get presale access.

    Good to have 23 apps

    B

    Bolt: Request a Ride

    Getting around

    Second ride app. Often cheaper than Grab, so compare both before each ride. Has XL and Van cars for groups of up to 6.

    At home
    Install at home and sign up with your phone number and the code it sends. Add a card, but also carry cash.
    Works
    Phuket. At Phuket airport only drop-offs at the terminal; for pickups you walk out of the airport gate. Koh Phangan: no. Koh Samui and Natai: not confirmed.
    Cost
    Free app. Fares shown before you book.
    Tips & help
    • 2026 guides say Bolt is often 5-30% cheaper than Grab in Phuket. Check both apps.
    • Bolt drivers cannot pick up at the airport terminal. They wait outside the airport gate, a 5-10 minute walk with bags.
    • Bolt's Thai licence ran out in May 2026. In July it still ran on a temporary permit while the Land Transport Department decides. Keep Grab ready.
    • In early Sep 2026 Bolt briefly paused rides in Thailand to update driver records. Check that the app finds cars before you rely on it.
    • Card payment works, but many Phuket drivers prefer cash. Carry small notes.
    • Phuket ride types: Economy, Bolt, XL and Van (up to 6 people), and Taxi. You can schedule a ride from 30 minutes to 90 days ahead.
    • Safety: the Emergency Assist button, and 'Share location' sends your car and live position to a friend.
    Bolt in Phuket (official) ↗Bolt rides: booking ahead and safety ↗

    P

    Phuket Smart Bus

    Getting around

    Cheap bus along the west coast: Airport - Surin - Kamala - Patong - Karon - Kata - Rawai for 100 baht. Live bus map on the website. No app needed.

    At home
    Nothing to install. Bookmark the live map (phuketsmartbus.com/tracking). Have a contactless card or small notes.
    Works
    Phuket only. Route 1 starts outside the domestic terminal at HKT (Exit 3) and stops in Kamala. No stop in Nai Yang. Not on Koh Samui or Koh Phangan.
    Cost
    Route 1: 100 baht flat. Route 2: 50 baht. Dragon Line: free. Route 1 pass: 299 baht for 1 day, 799 for 7 days.
    Tips & help
    • From the airport every 30 minutes, 08:15-23:30. Last bus from Rawai to the airport 19:30. Times change with traffic.
    • Airport to Kamala takes about 50 minutes. Kamala to the airport: first bus about 06:15, last about 20:35 (Big C Kamala), about 1 hour 15 minutes.
    • At the airport: go out at Exit 3 of the domestic terminal, turn left and follow the public transport walkway to the blue Smart Bus sign.
    • Pay on board: tap a contactless Visa, Mastercard or JCB card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay cash. The QR is for Thai bank apps (PromptPay).
    • Route 2 runs Bus Terminal 2 - Phuket Town - Patong (50 baht). The Dragon Line in Old Town is free.
    • Help: LINE @pksb or WhatsApp +66 86 306 1257.
    • The Android app called 'Phuket Smart Bus' is unofficial. Use the website instead.
    Live bus map ↗Timetable ↗Fares and payment ↗Day passes ↗Find the bus stop at the airport ↗

    K

    Koh Phangan songthaews and taxis (no app)

    Getting around

    Ride apps do not work reliably on Koh Phangan. You use shared songthaew pickup trucks, private taxis and taxi boats. Always agree the price before you get in.

    At home
    Nothing to install. Ask your Ban Tai hotel for a driver's WhatsApp or LINE before you arrive.
    Works
    Koh Phangan only: Thong Sala pier, Ban Tai, Haad Rin and the party venues.
    Cost
    Shared truck about 200 baht per person from Thong Sala to Haad Rin (2026 guides); more late at night and on party nights.
    Tips & help
    • Do not count on Grab, Bolt or inDrive here: there are no or almost no drivers.
    • Songthaews wait at Thong Sala pier, mostly when boats arrive. Tell the driver where you go and agree the price per person.
    • Save the number of a good driver on day one, or ask your hotel to call one. Private taxis cost more than shared trucks.
    • Trucks get rare after dark. On Full Moon night they run through the night, but prices go up and they fill up fast. Plan the ride home.
    • Taxi boats serve beaches on the north and east coast.
    • Easier arrival: Lomprayah and Seatran sell boat tickets with a van to your Koh Phangan hotel (not Thong Nai Pan), 670-700 baht from Samui airport.
    P

    Phuket airport taxi and limousine counters

    Ferries, flights and airport

    Official counters at Phuket airport: fixed-price limousine cars and minibuses, metered taxis and shared minibuses. Easy for the big group on 8 Jan.

    At home
    Optional: book a fixed-price car or a minibus for the group online before the flight.
    Works
    Phuket airport (HKT), both terminals, right after the arrivals exit. Rides to all of Phuket, and to Natai and other provinces.
    Cost
    Car (up to 3): Nai Yang 400, Kamala 750, Patong 800 baht. Minibus (up to 10): Kamala 1,300. Taxi: meter + 100 baht.
    Tips & help
    • Phuket Airport Limousine has counters at the domestic exit Gate 1 and the international exit Gate 2. Prices are fixed and shown before you pay.
    • Prices on its website (Oct 2026), car for up to 3: Phuket Town 650, Kamala 750, Patong 800, Kata 1,000 baht. SUV for 4 (07:00-18:00 only): Kamala 1,100.
    • Minibus for 5-10 people: Nai Yang 600, Kamala 1,300, Patong 1,400 baht. Pay online by card, PromptPay or e-wallet, or at the counter.
    • Metered taxis wait outside the terminal at the 'Metered Taxi' sign. You pay the meter plus a 100-baht airport fee.
    • Shared minibus (P.M.K. counter), per person: 150 baht to Phuket Town, 180 to Patong, 200 to Kata or Rawai (official airport list).

    Install TAGTHAi, tap Easy Pay and pre-register with your passport, no more than 30 days before you visit the booth. Add a credit or debit card in the app before you fly.

    T

    TrueMoney - Pay & Earn Coins

    Money and payments

    Thai e-wallet. A foreigner can register with a passport and pay at 7-Eleven, shops and many QR codes. Only worth it if you get a Thai SIM number.

    At home
    Do it in Thailand after you get a Thai SIM: the code comes by SMS to a Thai number. Choose 'Non-Thai citizen', scan your passport and take a selfie with it. Approval takes 1-3 business days.
    Works
    All of Thailand, including Koh Phangan and Samui. Top up with cash at 7-Eleven counters and top-up kiosks.
    Cost
    Free app. Passport-only account: wallet up to 30,000 baht, transfers to other TrueMoney users up to 5,000 baht a month, no transfers to bank accounts (TrueMoney support, Oct 2026).
    Tips & help
    • If the passport check in the app fails, ask a 7-Eleven cashier for 'TrueMoney Passport KYC'.
    • Passport-only accounts cannot send money to bank accounts. Paying a stall's personal PromptPay QR may not work, so test with a small amount first.
    • Airalo and other data-only eSIMs have no Thai number, so they cannot get the TrueMoney SMS code.
    • Without a Thai bank account, top up with cash at 7-Eleven or a top-up kiosk.
    • TrueMoney is not in the Russian App Store (checked Oct 2026).

    Xe Money Transfer & Currency

    Money and payments

    Live exchange rates and a currency converter. Compare the money changer's board with the real (mid-market) rate before you change cash.

    At home
    Add THB and your home currency to the list.
    Works
    Anywhere with internet. The guide also has its own converter.
    Cost
    Free.
    Tips & help
    • On 16 Oct 2026 Mamy Exchange in Phuket paid about 0.5-0.9% under the mid-market rate for USD, EUR and GBP. Compare any exchange board with Xe.
    • You do not need the money transfer part of the app for this trip.

    M

    Mamy Exchange (live rates website)

    Money and payments

    Website with the live buy and sell rates of a Phuket money changer with good rates. Check the rate on your phone before you go to change cash.

    At home
    Bookmark mamyexchange.com. You can add their LINE account (@628dltlb) or use WhatsApp to ask a question.
    Works
    Phuket only: one shop at 9/10 Moo 4, Koh Kaew, on route 402 between the airport and Phuket Town. Not at the airport, not on Samui or Koh Phangan.
    Cost
    Free website. Rates on 16 Oct 2026, 15:14: they paid 33.25 baht per USD (50-100 notes), 37.35 per EUR and 44.20 per GBP.
    Tips & help
    • Big clean notes get the best rate: on 16 Oct 2026 USD 1-2 notes got 32.45 baht, USD 50-100 notes 33.25.
    • Phone: 088-193-1188 or 076-364-111 (Mamy website).

    L

    LINE MAN

    Food and delivery

    Big Thai food delivery app with 700,000+ restaurants, including many small local places. It translates menus into English, and your English chat with the rider reaches them in Thai.

    At home
    The store text says you log in with your LINE account. Make a LINE account at home (SMS code to your phone), then open LINE MAN and save your address.
    Works
    Phuket. LINE MAN says it serves all 77 provinces, but Koh Samui and Koh Phangan coverage is not confirmed.
    Cost
    Free app. The store text says delivery fees start at 0 baht with promotions.
    Tips & help
    • Try Grab first. Use LINE MAN when a small local place you want is not on Grab.
    • Many discounts are for Thai bank cards. We could not confirm that foreign cards work, so check the payment options before you order.
    • Rider chat is translated: you write in English and the rider sees Thai. There are English chat stickers too.
    English menus and rider chat (LINE MAN news) ↗

    D

    Delivery KPG

    Food and delivery

    Food delivery on Koh Phangan, where Grab does not run: 300+ restaurants, cafés and shops, in the app or on the website. Delivery takes about 45 to 60 minutes.

    At home
    Sign up with your WhatsApp number (country code, no '+' or spaces). The code comes by WhatsApp. You can also order on delivery-kpg.com.
    Works
    Koh Phangan only. Each restaurant delivers within its own range, so what you see depends on your address.
    Cost
    Minimum order 200 THB. The delivery fee depends on your location.
    Tips & help
    • Pay the driver in cash or by Thai QR code. The FAQ says card payment is only planned, so keep cash.
    • Open 08:00 to 23:45. You can cancel only within 5 minutes, and not once the restaurant starts cooking.
    • Help is on WhatsApp: +66 63 678 2760. Store reviews (2025-2026) mention app bugs and some orders cancelled without notice.
    How it works and FAQ (official) ↗

    W

    Wongnai

    Food and delivery

    Big Thai restaurant review site and app: ratings, photos, menus and prices from Thai diners. Use it as a second opinion next to Google Maps.

    At home
    On iPhone the app is only in the Thai App Store, so use the website. Android has a store listing.
    Works
    Restaurant listings across Thailand, including Phuket.
    Cost
    Free.
    Tips & help
    • The iPhone app is in the Thai App Store only. A foreign Apple ID cannot download it.
    • For English, open wongnai.com/?locale=en.
    • Many reviews are in Thai. Let your browser translate the page.

    V

    Vibez.io

    Parties and tickets

    Ticket shop and app used by Sacred Moon Phangan for Lost Jungle (Parvati Day & Night, 9 to 11 Jan). Your ticket is a QR code in your Vibez account.

    At home
    Sign up with your phone number. The 4-digit code comes by SMS or WhatsApp; choose WhatsApp if SMS to your number is slow.
    Works
    Lost Jungle, Koh Phangan, 9 to 11 Jan. Buy on web.vibez.io or in the app.
    Cost
    Free app.
    Tips & help
    • Lost Jungle (9 to 11 Jan) falls in your Phuket group week, before your Koh Phangan days. Check the dates before you buy.
    • Buying for friends? You can assign each ticket to a phone number, and Vibez sends that person a link to their ticket.
    • Find your QR under 'Tickets'. You can also download the QR image.
    • Some events are for members only and ask you to join the organiser's community first.

    GETIN (Get In)

    Parties and tickets

    Ticket site and app used by Utopia, the jungle rave at Than Sadet on Koh Phangan. Tickets live in the GETIN app, with a waiting list and transfers to friends.

    At home
    Only if you go to Utopia. Install GETIN and make the account before you buy, so the ticket shows on your phone.
    Works
    Utopia, Than Sadet, Koh Phangan. January dates were not out on 16 Oct 2026. Online, anywhere.
    Cost
    Free app. Utopia prices are in US dollars (Oct 2026 rounds: USD 65 to 97, door USD 103).
    Tips & help
    • Utopia's Oct 2026 page says 18+ and 'Bring ID'. Bring your passport.
    • Cannot go? The app lets you join a waiting list or send the ticket to a friend.
    • Prices rise with each round, so buy early if you are sure.

    H

    Hostelworld

    Hotels and tours

    Hostel booking app with a social side for your solo days: chats with people in your hostel and city, traveller profiles, and 'Linkups', meet-ups like bar crawls, dinners and tours.

    At home
    Install the app, make a profile and book a bed. No hostel booking? Buy a Social Pass in Profile Settings to join the city chats.
    Works
    Hostels in Phuket (the social ones in this guide are in Patong) and on Koh Phangan. City chats for Phuket.
    Cost
    Free app. Social Pass: EUR 4.99 a week or EUR 9.99 a month, a one-time payment, not a subscription (Sep 2026).
    Tips & help
    • Hostel and city chats open 7 days before check-in, Linkups 14 days before. Newer app texts call the meet-ups 'Events'.
    • Staying in a hotel near the airport? A 1-week Social Pass opens the Phuket city chat and meet-ups without a hostel booking.
    • Some Linkups cost money, and some hostels ask you to sign up at reception. Read the description.
    • Your bookings are saved in the app for offline use.

    GetYourGuide

    Hotels and tours

    Book tours and day trips with reviews. Most bookings have free cancellation up to 24 hours before, and some let you reserve now and pay later.

    At home
    Make an account and add your card. Tickets are saved in the app and work offline.
    Works
    Phuket tours and day trips. Check listings for Koh Samui and Koh Phangan.
    Cost
    Free app.
    Tips & help
    • Free cancellation up to 24 hours before covers most bookings, not all. Check each listing.
    • 'Reserve now, pay later' holds your spot, and you pay at a later date.
    • Compare the same tour on Klook. Check the pickup area, park fees and meals.
